canonical_decisions.statement: The governing architecture is HPVS -> HZT-M0-S6/HZT-M0-P5 -> HZT-Full.
UniverseLab is the operational integration layer, not the physical theory itself.
Technical execution is not physical identification; numerical stability is not ghost freedom; good fit is not theory confirmation.
K1-D remains NOT RELEASED and K1-E remains NOT ADMISSIBLE.
No further branch-level phenomenology is promoted before SCI-001/SCI-002 parent and boundary closure and MD-2S recovery.
canonical_decisions.source_of_truth: Research continuation program and parent closure profiles

canonical_decisions.statement: Global A0 benchmarks do not determine one-sided boundary derivatives or the two-junction verdict.
The light unscreened radion route is blocked by excessive coupling in the tested minimal realization.
The intrinsic RB0 chameleon route is rejected in the tested minimal realization because it behaves anti-chameleon-like.
The minimal cubic EGB Vainshtein route vanishes for two internal dimensions in the tested construction.
Two normal directions cannot be interpreted as two independent physical fluids because of the SO(2) normal-bundle gauge freedom.
DESI, Pantheon+, KiDS/DES, RSD, SPARC and GW likelihoods become theory tests only after a released model-dependent forward map.
The current delivery target is a mobile-first browser/PWA research platform; native clients remain optional later targets.
canonical_decisions.source_of_truth: Repository runtime and resolved chat history

canonical_decisions.statement: Cellular automata are mathematical and heuristic demonstrators and are not identified with real cosmological structure formation.
